description: Commvault CommCell syslog/SIEM pack for AuditTrail, Events, and Alerts. Includes SC4S dedicated TLS listener guidance, parser config, family-specific Splunk sourcetypes, CIM-oriented normalized fields, Splunk props/transforms/eventtypes/tags exports, a SOC overview dashboard (anomaly/ransomware indicators, authentication and login-source tracking, privileged audit operations, backup job health), an Eventcode-to-event-string lookup with a documentation-page builder script, and test events for validation.

event_families.label: Commvault base/unclassified and media movement events
event_families.notes: Fixture coverage for dashboard panels that surface tape movement and unclassified base events.

supported_transports.label: TLS syslog RFC5425
supported_transports.notes: Recommended production transport for Commvault CommCell into SC4S.

supported_transports.label: TCP syslog RFC5424
supported_transports.notes: Use when TLS termination is handled elsewhere or source cannot use TLS.

supported_transports.label: UDP syslog BSD/headerless
supported_transports.notes: Supported for lab/legacy use only; avoid for production where event loss matters.

supported_transports.label: TCP syslog BSD/headerless
supported_transports.notes: Legacy/plain TCP option when source emits BSD/headerless payloads.

source_log_version.name: Commvault Platform Release
source_log_version.notes: Commvault syslog/SIEM field shape validated from current documentation and representative samples; set min/max when customer source version is confirmed.

validation.source_log_version: Commvault documentation current as of 2026-05-26; lab samples for AuditTrail, Events, Alerts
validation.evidence: SC4S TLS 20029 dedicated-listener replay produced Splunk indexed read-back for the 3/3 Commvault fixture markers; evidence bundle: docs/evidence/sc4s-library-replay-20260605T230445Z/. Current retained summaries prove the dedicated listener and exact marker count, while refreshed pack-aware replay/read-back is still required for the renamed family sourcetypes and index=commvault assertion.

timestamp_policy.notes: Commvault samples include Utctimestamp epoch seconds and local display-time fields. Parser should prefer Utctimestamp. If a source omits it, the pack must be amended with the source host or application timezone before production validation.

field_delimiting.notes: Do not split values on raw spaces inside braces. Treat each physical line as the event boundary for these fixtures.

source.reference: Commvault public documentation and Jarvis lab synthetic validation fixtures
source.notes: Fixtures are synthetic equivalents shaped from documented CommCell AuditTrail, Events, and Alerts fields.

curation.notes: Curated parser, Splunk knowledge, and fixtures for SecHub Resources SC4S pack.

logging_presets.label: Basic
logging_presets.description: Parser and required Splunk knowledge only; no reduction/drop behaviour.
logging_presets.notes: Functional config stays in referenced .conf files.

logging_presets.label: Standard
logging_presets.description: SOC default for family-specific sourcetypes and CIM-oriented knowledge without event drops.
logging_presets.notes: No reduction rules are enabled in the standard preset; the reviewed alert-drop postfilter remains enhanced/optional only.

logging_presets.label: Enhanced
logging_presets.description: Adds the reviewable postfilter reduction artifact to drop Commvault alert-family noise before Splunk indexing.

artifact_references.notes: Routes matching Commvault alert-family events to the SC4S null queue before indexing.

logging_presets.notes: Reduction remains optional and file-backed; enable only after validating alert-family volume trade-offs.

reduction_rules.label: Drop Commvault alert-family noise
reduction_rules.description: Routes Alert/Alerts fixture traffic to the SC4S null queue so noisy alert families can be reduced before Splunk indexing.
reduction_rules.safety_notes: Optional preset only. Review alert coverage before enabling in production because matching events are discarded before indexing.
reduction_rules.validation_spl: index=commvault "<MARKER>_ALERT" earliest=-2h | stats count by sourcetype source | where count > 0
reduction_rules.pre_enable_validation: Replay a marked alert fixture without this postfilter and confirm it indexes as sourcetype=commvault:commcell:alert; then enable the postfilter and confirm the same marker is absent from index=commvault.
reduction_rules.rollback: Remove sc4s/postfilters/app-postfilter-commvault_commcell-drop-alerts.conf from the active SC4S postfilter include set and reload/restart SC4S; basic and standard presets do not reference this artifact.

cim.notes: Primary mapping target uses Splunk CIM/common fields exposed by props/transforms and normalized_fields.

action.notes: Event-family action is derived from Commvault family/type.

signature.notes: Best available human-readable signature per family.

severity.notes: Severity values are preserved from source fields.

user.notes: Available for AuditTrail events where present.

ocsf.notes: Secondary OCSF alignment is descriptive until OCSF class-specific output is added.

activity_id.notes: Maps to event identifiers when family is known.

severity_id.notes: Requires future value normalization for complete OCSF severity IDs.

ecs.notes: ECS mapping is optional/reference only for this pack version.

known_limitations: Quality status is validated from lab replay/read-back evidence and synthetic-equivalent fixtures; field_validated promotion still requires real CommCell source-version evidence and retained read-back artifacts.

The Events and Alerts family sourcetypes were renamed (commvault:commcell:events -> commvault:commcell:event, commvault:commcell:alerts -> commvault:commcell:alert) after the recorded replay/read-back evidence, which shows the old names. props rename stanzas keep previously indexed data searchable under the new names; re-run replay/read-back to refresh the evidence for the renamed sourcetypes.

The SOC dashboard, login-detail extractions (cv_login_src, cv_login_from, cv_login_machine, cv_login_reason), and Eventcode lookup were added after the recorded replay/read-back evidence and are shaped from production-representative AuditTrail samples plus the user-supplied working searches; verify panels against live data before relying on them operationally.

splunk/lookups/commvault_eventcodes.csv (37,681 codes) was generated by scripts/build_commvault_eventcode_lookup.py from an operator-supplied tab-separated export of the 2024e System Messages, Event Strings and Error Codes documentation page (banner: Updated Sun, Jan 18, 2026). The docs site is unreachable/bot-gated from the build network, so refresh the lookup with the script via --html-file/--text-file from a saved copy after Commvault documentation updates.
Commvault field availability and wording can vary by platform release and SIEM/syslog configuration; update source_log_version min/max after confirming a production source version.

The enhanced alert-drop postfilter is optional and lossy. Basic and standard presets do not enable it; enable only after replay/read-back testing confirms alert-family evidence is intentionally excluded.

Clientname is part of the documented Commvault alert shape and is kept as a dest fallback in props (coalesce skips it when absent) and in the synthetic alert fixture, but production alert events observed so far do not carry it; the dashboard groups alert panels by Companyname instead, with the affected client visible in Alertdescription.

Collector wrappers, file/API/export relays, source-local timezone fallback, and customer-specific Eventcode coverage require additional retained evidence.

splunk_app.label: Commvault CommCell Custom
splunk_app.description: SecHub Resources Splunk knowledge for Commvault CommCell: family sourcetypes, CIM-oriented fields, login-detail extractions, Eventcode lookup, and the SOC overview dashboard.
splunk_app.author: S6 Security Labs
splunk_app.notes: Packaged as commvault_custom-<version>.tgz. For a customer-prefixed copy (e.g. ZZ_commvault_custom) run scripts/package_splunk_app.py commvault_commcell --prefix ZZ_; uppercase prefixes sort first in ASCII and therefore override lowercase-named apps in Splunk's global config precedence.
